name: blumira-mcp
description: Every Blumira finding, detection, and agent across your direct org and every MSP sub-account - in one offline-searchable store with cross-account triage and over-time trends no single API call can answer.

blumira_api_token.title: BLUMIRA_API_TOKEN
blumira_api_token.description: Optional. Blumira JWT bearer token. Minted+cached by `auth login`, or set directly. Set this OR BLUMIRA_CLIENT_ID + BLUMIRA_CLIENT_SECRET.

blumira_client_id.title: BLUMIRA_CLIENT_ID
blumira_client_id.description: Optional. Blumira API Client ID (Settings > Organization > Generate API Credentials). Used with BLUMIRA_CLIENT_SECRET by `auth login` to mint a JWT.

blumira_client_secret.title: BLUMIRA_CLIENT_SECRET
blumira_client_secret.description: Optional. Blumira API Client Secret. Used with BLUMIRA_CLIENT_ID by `auth login` to mint a JWT (client_credentials, audience=public-api).

blumira_base_url.title: Blumira API base URL
blumira_base_url.description: Base URL for the Blumira API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

blumira_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only mode
blumira_mcp_read_only.description: Set to 1 to make the MCP server refuse every write: only read tools are callable. Leave blank to allow writes (each MCP write still previews and sends only when called again with confirm set to true). Preset to 1; clear it only when you want the agent to make changes.

blumira_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
blumira_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API, the response cache is off and sync refuses to run. Leave blank to keep the local store.

blumira_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
blumira_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Blumira requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's built-in User-Agent.

blumira_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
blumira_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment); at least 32 characters. Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile
printing_press_client_profile.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile. Leave blank to use the profile configured as default_client_profile.
